capabilities: Chat with Pi beside your notes on desktop or mobile
Attach notes and images to conversations
Switch models and reasoning effort from plugin settings
Pair devices with the computer bridge via code or QR scan
Resume earlier conversations from history after restarts
extras: Default permission preset is full access, allowing file edits and shell commands; the README warns permission presets are not filesystem sandboxes. The computer bridge must keep running in a terminal; deeper connection help and advanced configuration live in a separate user guide. No telemetry or hosted relay; messages route through your computer to the model provider.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with a self-hosted AI agent and pass note context to it, especially from mobile.

relations.evidence: For remote access, use Tailscale on both devices.

requires.name: Pi with Node.js 22.19+ on a computer on the same network
Sign-in to a model provider configured in Pi

summary: Bridge plugin that chats with Pi, an AI agent running on your computer, from Obsidian on desktop or mobile, with note and image attachments.
